requirement_table.text: Register 0x000 reads 0x20950001.
Register 0x004 reads the USR_ACCESSE2 word.
SCRATCH at 0x008 reads back the written 32-bit value.
SCRATCH at 0x008 reads 0 after reset.
Unmapped addresses read 0.
A write to an unmapped address changes no register.
h_rdata shows the addressed register within 2 clk cycles of h_re.
h_rdata keeps its value after it shows the addressed register until the next h_re.
The FIFO holds 512 words of 32 bits.
The writer writes one PRBS-31 word (x^31 + x^28 + 1, seed 0x7FFFFFFF) on every clk cycle while RUN is 1 and the FIFO is not full.
The reader checks each word against its own PRBS-31 copy started from seed 0x7FFFFFFF when RUN begins.
With a correct data path DATA_ERRS stays 0 over a 10 minute run.
OVERFLOWS stays 0 over a 10 minute run.
UNDERFLOWS stays 0 over a 10 minute run.
With SLOW_READ set the reader takes at most 1 word in every 8 gt_refclk cycles.
With SLOW_READ set the FIFO reaches 512 words of fill.
STALL_W increments by 1 per clk cycle in which the writer is held off by a full FIFO.
INJECT flips exactly one bit of exactly one received word.
One INJECT raises DATA_ERRS by exactly 1.
INJECT clears itself after one use.
CLEAR with RUN 0 zeroes all seven counters.
CLEAR with RUN 0 restarts both PRBS sequences from the seed 0x7FFFFFFF.
CLEAR written while RUN is 1 has no effect.
A write to 0x030 latches all seven counters at one instant.
Counters wrap at 2^32.
OCC_MAX holds the highest FIFO fill seen in words.
OCC_MAX never exceeds 512.
WORDS_W advances at 25 million words per second while RUN is 1.
WORDS_R advances at 25 million words per second on average when SLOW_READ is 0.
sfp_tx_disable is 1 at all times.

The two clocks are declared in asynchronous clock groups.
Every CDC path carries a set_max_delay -datapath_only constraint.
